suppliers.label: NVIDIA
suppliers.disclosed_mix: FY26 10-K: 2 direct customers = 22% and 14% of revenue; CFO Kress said top 5 cloud providers are >50% of data-center revenue (Feb 2026).

suppliers.label: AMD
suppliers.disclosed_mix: No single customer hit 10% of FY2025 revenue per 10-K, despite multi-GW hyperscaler/AI-lab deals — AMD discloses deal sizes, not a % mix.

suppliers.label: TSMC
suppliers.disclosed_mix: HPC (AI/accelerators) ~66% of Q2 2026 revenue per earnings call; TSMC doesn't disclose customer %, but Nvidia+Apple+AMD+Broadcom est. ~65-70% combined.

suppliers.label: Broadcom
suppliers.disclosed_mix: One customer = ~50% of AI semis in Q3 FY26; top 5 customers ~55% of total revenue (10-Q); mgmt cites 6 custom-XPU customers overall.

suppliers.label: MediaTek
suppliers.disclosed_mix: CEO Rick Tsai: ASIC revenue to top $1B in 2026, mainly from the Google TPU program; no customer-level % breakdown given.

suppliers.label: Micron
suppliers.disclosed_mix: No customer reached 10% of FY2026 revenue (down from 17% in FY2025) per 10-K; HBM output sold out through 2026-2027 across a diversified base.

suppliers.label: SK Hynix
suppliers.disclosed_mix: Nvidia = 13.35% of 1H26 revenue, down from 24% in FY2025, per company disclosure, as HBM sales diversify toward ASIC/hyperscaler customers.

suppliers.label: Samsung Electronics
suppliers.disclosed_mix: Nvidia not in Samsung's top 5 customers per 1H26 disclosure (TrendForce); Samsung's HBM market share rose 21%→33% of global HBM, Q1→Q2 2026.

suppliers.label: Microsoft
suppliers.disclosed_mix: Microsoft disclosed ~$10B of quarterly Azure revenue tied to OpenAI (Oct 2026 earnings) — OpenAI is Azure's single largest AI compute customer.

suppliers.label: Oracle
suppliers.disclosed_mix: OpenAI's $300B contract alone is roughly half of Oracle's ~$664B total RPO backlog as of Aug 2026, per company disclosures.

suppliers.label: Meta Platforms
